name: Imperial Palace Grade Ancient Tree Ripe Pu-erh with Camphor Notes
marketing_tip: Experience the regal richness of Imperial-grade ripe Pu-erh, aged to perfection with distinct camphor undertones and a velvet-smooth finish.
body: This "Gong Ting" (Imperial Palace) grade ripe Pu-erh is crafted from fine buds harvested from ancient tea trees. It boasts a deep, earthy liquor with a unique camphor aroma that emerges through careful aging. The texture is exceptionally thick and creamy, offering a comforting warmth and a long-lasting, soothing sweetness.
